info.name: Sprint 1 - Users, Audit Logging, Notifications
info.description:
Security Incident Detection and Response Management System.
Services: Users (5001), Security Audit Logging (5005), Notifications (5008).
Run folder 0 first; tokens are stored automatically. Set `student_name` and `service_key` (SERVICE_API_KEY from .env) in the collection variables.
